questions.question: How are DEEP results displayed in Insights Stream?
questions.notes: Deep results appear in timeline order with other insights. Badges distinguish types.

questions.question: How is user notified when DEEP completes?
questions.notes: Toast with 'Deep search found X results'. If Insights visible, results appear with animation.

questions.question: Can user cancel running DEEP search?
questions.notes: Omnibar shows 'Searching...' with X button. Cancel clears search state.

questions.question: How many DEEP searches can run concurrently?
questions.notes: New DEEP search cancels previous. Simplest model.

analysis: DEEP search integration: Results mix chronologically in Insights Stream with type badges, toast notification on completion, cancellable via Omnibar X button, only one DEEP search at a time.
